body:
I am getting an error where it appears I am specifying the proper signature for this device function, but it is still throwing an invalid usage of function error when compiling.  I am also a fairly new numba user so this could very well be user error

```numba.errors.TypingError: Failed at nopython (nopython frontend)
Invalid usage of Function(<DeviceFunction py_func=<function devfunc at 0x0000000F32607A60> signature=(array(float64, 1d, C),) -> float64>) with parameters (array(float64, 1d, C))
Known signatures:
* (array(float64, 1d, C),) -> float64
File "testingstuff.py", line 13


```

```python 
import numpy as np
from numba import cuda

@cuda.jit('float64(float64[::1])',device=True)
def devfunc(arr):
    return 1.0;

@cuda.jit('void(float64[:])')
def kern(arr):
    toarr=cuda.local.array(10,'float64')
    for i in range(10):
        toarr[i] = arr[i]
    print(devfunc(toarr))

kern[1,1](np.zeros(10))
```
title: Support dtype from string spec in CUDA array allocators
